_comment: Everything the page shows comes from this file. Edit it, save, reload. No build step, no rebuild, no deploy needed if you are opening index.html directly.
name: Cake Pancake
tagline: Roblox with my friends. New videos most weeks.
_handle_note: The YouTube handle, without the @ and without the ?si= share tracker. This is separate from the channel's display name (Cake Pancake) and from the Roblox username. The Subscribe button is built from it, so a typo here sends everyone to a dead page. Changeable only once every 14 days.
_videos_note: The id is the part of a YouTube URL after watch?v= . For youtube.com/watch?v=dQw4w9WgXcQ the id is dQw4w9WgXcQ. Newest first. Delete these three examples once there are real ones.
_links_note: Anything else he is on. Delete the ones that do not apply — an empty list hides the whole section.
